title: Coherent systems on a tower of thickenings
statement: Let $(T_n)_{n\ge0}$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $i_n:T_n\to T_{n+1}$ morphisms. Define $\mathrm{Sys}(T_\bullet,i_\bullet)$ to have objects families of coherent $\mathcal O_{T_n}$-modules $\mathcal F_n$ [pqf-def-coherent] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with isomorphisms $\varphi_n:i_n^*\mathcal F_{n+1}\cong\mathcal F_n$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. A morphism from $(\mathcal F_n,\varphi_n)$ to $(\mathcal G_n,\varphi_n\prime)$ is a family $u_n:\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal G_n$ satisfying $\varphi_n\prime\circ i_n^*u_{n+1}=u_n\circ\varphi_n$. Identities and composition are componentwise. Evaluation at $n$ sends a system to $\mathcal F_n$ and a morphism to $u_n$. In Remark 088F take $T_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec} A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and the canonical transition maps [def-pc-base-change].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Remark 088F (remark-reformulate-existence-theorem), systems and their compatible morphisms; indices shifted by one

proof.text: Identity compatibility follows from Functor.map_id and the left and right identity laws in each module category.
For composite families, rewrite Functor.map_comp, reassociate, substitute f.compatibility n and g.compatibility n, and reassociate again.

Define identity and composition componentwise using the preceding compatibility proofs. Destruct the Hom structures; the two identity laws and associativity reduce to the corresponding module category laws, with proof irrelevance for the compatibility fields. These laws give the category instance, and evaluation is componentwise.
